verdict.rationale: LlamaExtract documents extraction "with citations" so values can be verified against the source document. Parse separately offers source-page provenance for tables and bounding boxes for form fields. The evidence does not show that every extracted field carries all three elements of provenance together. missing for 10: documented per-field page numbers, bounding boxes and source snippets in Extract output, provenance on every field rather than only tables and forms, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, every extracted field carries provenance — page number, bounding box, source snippet — so agents can cite and humans can verify

citations.quote: Extract structured data from SEC filings with citations. Verify values against the source document when extracting from complex financial documents.
pull every table out into pandas DataFrames with source-page provenance
fields with values, checkbox states, and bounding boxes
